chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Faces a Spider-Puppet Threat in “The Shadow at the Window”
chapter_meta_description: A rare night of peace ends when a strange spider-puppet entity appears at Li Huowang’s window. The Second Spirit warns him with a bite. Chapter 151 of Dao Gui Yi Xian.
og_title: The Second Spirit Bites—A Spider-Puppet Crawls the Wall
og_description: Li Huowang’s brief rest is shattered by a shadow-puppet entity that speaks his name. Chapter 151 of the folk-horror epic.
twitter_title: Something’s here. The Second Spirit already knows.
twitter_description: A spider with an old man’s face taps at the window. Li Huowang is already reaching for his sword.
